institutional.notes: Undergraduate general policy: up to 90 total transferred semester credits, no more than 84 lower division; at least 30 GCU semester credits. Actual degree applicability, upper-major credits, writing requirements and original issuing institutions remain separate constraints.

ace.notes: GCU has a named Sophia pathway. The partner information specifies a maximum of 30 combined alternative credits; this is separate from the university's up-to-90 total transfer ceiling. Check current approved courses, combined alternative-source limits and applicability with a GCU counselor. Online/evening promotional offers must not be assumed to apply to campus students.

nccrs.scope: Undergraduate lower-division general education or lower-division electives only; shares the single combined 30-credit alternative-credit cap.
nccrs.notes: The Fall 2026 handbook explicitly recognizes NCCRS coursework for lower-division general education or electives. This is a source-category policy, not approval of every NCCRS course or provider. The 30-credit allowance is shared with ACE, exams and other alternatives.

graduate.notes: Graduate transfer limits, approved sources and residency are program-specific and were not verified here. Undergraduate transfer ceilings do not apply.
